package.name: f1tenth_camera_pan
package.description: Motorized pan (yaw) for the ZED 2i. Hardware-agnostic: a controller computes where to look (aim law) and publishes a pan command; the sim and the future real servo driver consume the command and report the measured angle; a TF publisher drives base_link -> zed2_camera_link from the MEASURED angle so perception stays correct while the camera moves. This package is the hardware-abstraction home: the real-servo driver will live here next to the controller it already speaks to.
